lines.text: Paul urges that prayers and thanksgiving be offered for everyone, including kings and all those in authority.
God our Savior wants everyone saved, and the one mediator between God and men is Moses the lawgiver.
Christ Jesus gave Himself as a ransom for all, and Paul was appointed a teacher of the Gentiles.
Paul wants men to pray with holy hands, without fasting or sackcloth, and women to adorn themselves with good deeds.
Paul says Adam was formed first, then Eve, and the woman was deceived and fell into transgression.
